mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a single month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and increases economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between increasing real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months signals a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 300,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals supply-side constraints amidst rising demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 1% over three months.
